events.title: Обновление 0.0.2.1910
events.summary: The update introduces a new mode called “Custom Cards,” where you can design your own suits and values, which will then be applied to the cards in the deck. The build includes several QOL improvements.AddedAdded the “Custom Cards” mode, where players can draw a suit and all its values themselves. This mode makes it easier to trick other players.Added a panel showing the correct suit designs in the bottom‑left corner of the screen.Added a warning reminding players to adhere to fair play principle
